content.short: CroSkull NFT centers croSkulls in the Underworld with adventures and treasures.
content.description: CroSkull NFT centers on CroSkulls in the Underworld, focusing on the ecosystem, staking, and community-driven adventures. In Adventure mode, CroSkulls can be sent on expeditions to passively earn 3 $GRVE daily. EvoSkull is the evolved form of a CroSkull; evolution requires a Purple Potion, and EvoSkulls can claim 9 $GRVE daily. EvoSkulls and Pets can be sent on Missions to earn $SLS (Souls). These features combine to offer ongoing participation, growth through evolution, and reward opportunities within CroSkull NFT’s Underworld universe.
